here: Here: all 386 Pokémon of Generations I–III (Bulbasaur to Deoxys, default forms, today's base stats and types), as their six base stats z-scored (A) and as DINOv2 embeddings of the classic front sprite, cropped and set on white (B); colours mark the primary type.
